## skill-validator-omni 2.5.1

- Updated SKILL.md for minor version and documentation changes.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- No functional or standards changes to validation logic reported.

- Removed the sample file skill-card.md.
- No other functional or standards-related changes in this release.

- Initial release of skill-validator-omni.
- Validates skills and repos against seven major authoring standards, including Agent Plugins 1.0.0, agentskills.io, Anthropic best practices, Hermes in-repo, OpenAgent skills.sh, Claude Code, and OpenAI Codex.
- Audits skill manifests, directory structure, frontmatter, and installability across all major agent ecosystems.
- CLI and local script support: runs via `npx skill-validator-omni` (Node.js 18+ required) or `node scripts/validate.js`.
- Reports detailed PASS/FAIL per standard; designed for CI gating and pre-publish checks.
- Enables skill authors to certify universal installability and compliance before distribution.
